interfaces.review_pending: {status:pending_review,...}; raises PendingEvaluationReview, retaining completed evaluate cache. Later explicit advance invokes only the pure reviewer again until approval.
interfaces.review_approved: Exact status approved, binding, envelope, envelope_hash=digest(envelope), review_receipt_hash=64hex. Approved envelope validated then frozen with approval_hash.
interfaces.bundle: root/files/index_path/manifest_hash; entire manifest checked and copied; index records require public visibility and allowed origin, receipt IDs map to indexed public evidence. Program checks permitted only when explicitly public.

verified_behaviors: Two pending resumes call evaluate once for that task; subsequent approval advances without replacing cached paid completion. Finished resume invokes neither evaluator nor reviewer again.
Review cannot approve a different request/evaluation or altered score/feedback envelope hash; frozen review mutation rejects before callbacks.
Resume cannot disable an already selected external-review policy.
Unknown paid callback exception never calls reviewer, never reruns paid evaluation, and never becomes scientific zero.
No private/test path or controller projection root forwarded to builder; staged search-only public evidence preserves index and receipt resolution.
Mutated bundle and private-tagged index rejected; score/private-rationale records are not permitted public origins.
compatibility: No-review path retains trusted preaccepted synthetic adapter support, labeled in persisted review_policy.json; this is not admission for actual native outputs.
limits: A Python callback is a trusted controller adapter, not a side-effect sandbox. Pure reviewer MUST NOT invoke models; no model client/call capability is passed, but arbitrary Python side effects cannot be technically excluded by this interface.
Filesystem and receipt hashes are integrity bindings, not signatures or immunity to a compromised controller.

Public visibility alone does not establish semantic safety. Actual evaluator must bind external semantic-feedback and public-projection review; host/private path contents require review even when role is public.
Known completed evaluations pending approval can resume. Unknown paid outcomes/in-flight crashes remain explicit unresolved stops with no automatic retry.
Per-file staging is hash checked; no claim of arbitrary filesystem atomicity or formal process isolation.
Actual StageEvaluationAdapter/ReadOnlyReviewResolver integration and real native evolution are separate workstreams; no live calls in these tests.
related_agent: container_runtime_v2 supplies actual evaluator/projection/resolver with the agreed envelope API; root supplies native builder/selection adapters
verdict: Two-phase recovery and public evidence plumbing pass bounded synthetic tests; not real self-improvement or formal benchmark acceptance
